plainText:
Olivia (Japanese: ライチ Lychee) is a character introduced in . She is the kahuna of Akala Island and a member of the Alola Elite Four. She specializes in . She grants the Akala Trial Completion stamp to Trainers who defeat her in a grand trial.

==In the core series games==
===Character profile===
 
In addition to being Akala's kahuna, Olivia owns a jewelry and accessory store in her hometown of Konikoni City. Despite being chosen as a kahuna at such a young age, Olivia maintains that she is just an average girl. The eventually battles her in the grand trial of Akala.

Olivia is later revealed to be one of the s Professor Kukui invited to act as the Elite Four of the of Alola.

===Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon===
====Background====
Website blurb: "Olivia is the kahuna of Akala Island, the second island you visit on your island challenge. Her skill is extraordinary, as can only be expected from someone chosen to serve as kahuna at such a young age. Yet she still insists that she is just a normal girl."

Olivia is one of Alola's four island kahunas, who first debuts in and returns in . As kahuna of Akala Island she helps govern the island and participates in battle for the grand trials on Akala Island.

====Story====
Once the player and their friends makes their way to Heahea City on Akala Island, Olivia, as well as Mallow, one of Akala's Trial Captains, will greet them. The two were in the middle of Mallow's deliveries before spotting the group. She forms of friendly banter with Professor Kukui and tells Hau and the player that she is excited for their grand trials. Olivia leaves with Mallow. If the player attemps to leave for Diglett's Tunnel before doing all three of Akala's trials, Olivia will prevent the player from going deep within the area. Depending on what trials and areas the player has visted, she'll direct them on where to go.

By the time all three trials have been completed and once the player has visted the Dimensional Research Lab, she will appear in Diglett's Tunnel and tells tells them that she will be waiting at her jewelry shop in Konikoni City. However, making it to her store reveals that she is missing. Her brings the protagonist a note saying that Olivia is currently doing work for at the Ruins of Life. Making it to the ruins, she is seen with Lillie, who has managed to get lost and Professor Burnet has brought her to Olivia for protection. Olivia challenges the player to the grand trial, to which Lillie and Nebby happily watch for their own enjoyment. After the battle, Olivia provides the player with a Rockium Z and then questions Lillie's purpose for coming to the ruins despite not being a Pokémon Trainer, where as most people and Pokémon tend to stay away from the tapu due to fear. Olivia is pleased with Lillie's answer of coming for Nebby's sake, and brings the two back to Konikoni before being stopped by Hau who tells the player about their upcoming visit to Aether Paradise. Off screen, Olivia battles Hau for his grand trial. At the Hano Grand Resort, she sees the player and Hau off, giving them some advice, "Your greatest opponent is always yourself. Your greatest allies, the Pokémon beside you." Once a day, after her grand trial, when ordering a Z-set from Mallow's restaurant, Olivia will appear and order for both herself and the player. Additionally, she will give the player the two Heart Scales as part of the dish order, giving the player a total of four.

In , after unleashes several Ultra Beasts into Alola, Olivia is briefly seen facing either a in Ultra Sun or a in Ultra Moon at the Ruins of Life.

After Professor Kukui has successfully set up the Alola Pokémon League on Mount Lanakila, it is revealed that Olivia was asked to be one of Alola's Elite Four. In exclusively, Olivia appears in a photograph with her eating at Mallow's restaurant.

Olivia can be encountered in her own house in Konikoni City in the post-game.

===Pokémon===
Olivia specializes in using Rock-Type Pokémon. Her , who is in its Midnight form, is seen in every battle against the protagonist and is considered her main partner Pokémon. Lycanroc makes further appearance in Sun and Moon's end credits. It returns in other media such as Pokémon Masters EX. She is also affiliated with and more prominently, , also having either of the two except for the Grand Trial match in Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon.

A Probopass is often seen around her Jewelry store and provides the player with directions to her to take on the Grand Trial. This Probopass is different from the Nosepass and Probopass that accompany her in battles. A Single Stufful is found among her fake moving toys.

Olivia's Pokémon in battle are all kept in Ultra Balls.

===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
 
While not mentioned by name, in The Guardian's Challenge, it is revealed that completed Olivia's grand trial and received a Z-Ring from her prior to the start of .

She partially appeared in Young Kiawe Had a Farm! during a flashback, when Kiawe told that the Z-Ring and Firium Z he had received from Olivia was his grandfather's. She was also mentioned in A Glaring Rivalry! when revealed that he obtained his Rockium Z from completing her grand trial.

Olivia physically debuted in The Island Whisperer!, where she traveled to Melemele Island and visited the Pokémon School, taking and to visit Akala Island. She continued to appear during throughout Ash and his classmates' stay on the island, first in Treasure Hunt, Akala Style!, where she organized a class involving treasure hunting using Stoutland Search. During the treasure hunt, found a Sparkling Stone, which Olivia took to be converted into a Z-Ring. The finished Z-Ring was returned to Lana in the next episode.

In Currying Favor and Flavor!, Olivia sent Ash and his classmates on a search for ingredients for the famous "Akala Curry". Ash was paired up with , with their search eventually leading them to Lush Jungle, where Ash was challenged by . After Ash defeated Lurantis, Olivia showed up and revealed that the entire search had actually been a part of Ash's trial, and he now qualified to take on her grand trial.

In Trials and Determinations!, she battled Ash in his Akala Island grand trial at the Ruins of Life, using Lycanroc and in a Double Battle against and . Despite their two opponents giving them a lot of trouble, Rowlet finally managed to defeat Probopass with , only for Rockruff to impulsively attack and knock out Rowlet out of its desire to battle Lycanroc alone. Despite this setback, Rockruff was still able to defeat its evolved form, winning the battle for Ash. After the battle, Olivia gave Ash a Rockium Z and told him that Rockruff's behavior was a sign of it being ready to evolve soon.

In The Professors' New Adventure!, Olivia attended the wedding of and .

She reappeared in flashbacks in Some Kind of Laziness! and Not Caving Under Pressure!.

In Full Moon and Many Arms!, Olivia was seen praying at the Ruins of Life while she waited for the Manalo Festival to begin. In Securing the Future!, she joined the rest of Alola in restoring to its by lending it some of her Z-Power.

In Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!, Olivia met up with Ash and his classmates again when they visited Akala alongside and , who were visiting Alola. Brock became infatuated with her, resulting in Misty dragging him away. She agreed to a battle and used Lycanroc against but the battle was interrupted by who attempted to steal the Pokémon. Brock and Olivia avoided capture and teamed up to attack Team Rocket with a heart shaped .

In The Dealer of Destruction!, Olivia, her fellow kahunas, and helped Professor Kukui reveal the Alola League to the public.

In A Recipe for Success!, Olivia was visiting Aina's Kitchen when Abe asked Mallow to collect some ingredients from . Mallow was gone for a while helping out at the Café, so Olivia started helping Abe at the Kitchen and was later joined by Ash and the rest of his classmates. Olivia later watched as Mallow returned with a Grassium Z given by , and a Z-Ring given by Oranguru. She then cleaned and decorated the Z-Ring before giving it back to Mallow for her to use.

In Battle Royal 151!, Olivia appeared alongside her fellow kahunas, acting as a referee during the Battle Royal preliminary round of the Manalo Conference. In Battling Besties!, Olivia refereed the second pair of first-round matches: one between Hau and Samson Oak, and the other between Mallow and Lana. From Imitation Is the Sincerest Form of Strategy! to The Road to The Semifinals!, she continued observing the Manalo Conference battles. She then refereed the semifinals battle between Kiawe and in The Final Four! and Getting Down to The Ire!. Afterwards, in Final Rivals! and Enter the Champion!, she watched the finals battle between Ash and Gladion in the stands. After the final battle ended, Olivia attended the award ceremony for the winner, only for it to be interrupted when a arrived at the stadium through an Ultra Wormhole.

In Z-Move Showdown!, Olivia and the other island kahunas joined forces to battle Guzzlord. The guardian deities later came to their assistance, using their powers to keep Guzzlord in place long enough for Olivia and the others to fire off their Z-Moves. The combined attacks launched Guzzlord back into the wormhole it came out of, successfully sending it back into Ultra Space.

In Exhibition Unmasked!, Fiery Surprises!, and From Z to Shining Z!, Olivia watched the between Ash and Professor Kukui.

In Dreams of the Sun and Moon!, Olivia acted as the referee during Ash's battle against Kiawe. After the battle, Olivia spoke with Ash and motivated him to travel around the world.

====Character====
Olivia is highly energetic and sweet by nature. However, she is also very clumsy, constantly getting knocked to the ground during simple tasks like walking up the stairs or opening a door. She also possesses the unique ability to communicate with Pokémon on a different level than most people, giving her a natural affinity even with highly guarded and aggressive Pokémon such as Kiawe's Turtonator and Ash's Litten.

 ]]
Olivia debuted in The Delivery of Rotom and the Girl. She was first seen with Hala and Nanu at Malie Garden, where they discussed the sightings of the guardian deities around Alola. They speculated that the normally reclusive guardians appearing before people was a sign that they were angered by something.

In Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui, Olivia and Nanu battled each other to test a stage for an upcoming festival in Iki Town. Nanu teased Olivia about her romance troubles, which angered her into using a Z-Move. Nanu tried retaliating with his own, but both were stopped by Hala. The three decided the festival would be used to test Alolan youths by having they battle each other. The strongest participants would travel around Alola's four islands, imitating the island challenge, in order to calm the guardian deities' rage.

In The Decision and the Tournament of Six, helped Olivia determine the festival tournament roster. At one point, they encountered Lillie, a girl entered in the tournament due to a misunderstanding. When Lillie tried to explain the situation, Nebby escaped from her bag and ran off. Moon and Lillie chased after Nebby to Mahalo Trail while Olivia went to tell inform Hala. After returning, Olivia witnessed rescuing Moon and Nebby from falling in the water before leaving. Olivia offered to have Lillie withdrawn from the tournament, but Moon decided to take her place instead.

In Thieving and Boss Crabominable, Olivia, Hala, and Nanu met at Hala's house, where they decided to name Hapu the next kahuna of Poni Island. Olivia and Nanu decided to head to their respective islands to help the Trial Captains fend off the Ultra Beasts that appeared in Alola. Before they could leave, a and burst into the building and attacked. Hala decided to fight the two beasts alone and told Olivia and Nanu to go defend their islands.

In Adventure in the Dark Dimension, the island kahunas and Trial Captains were revealed to have spent six months on Exeggutor Island to prepare for another clash with the Ultra Beasts. At some point, Olivia made a Z-Ring for Hau. Once the training was finished, Olivia and Kahili left to join the others and deliver a repaired Z-Ring Kiawe. While they traveled, Kahili revealed a suitcase full of Z-Crystals she had spent the last six months gathering. One of the Z-Crystals was a Lycanium Z, which Olivia had never seen before.

After meeting with the others, Sophocles and Molayne took everyone to Mount Lanakila, where a wormhole had opened up earlier. Shortly after they arrived, their ship was attacked by a group of s and their Ultra Beasts. During the battle, Olivia was assisted by , who transported her to Melemele Island in order to battle with .

====Pokémon====

 

===Pokémon Horizon===
 
Olivia appeared in Attack on the Headquarters, during a flashback of 's adventures. She was shown handing him a Rockium Z after being defeated by him.

====Pokémon====
 
 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Olivia was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sun & Moon Series (the Japanese Sun & Moon Era). It was first released in the subset before debuting in English in the expansion, with an illustration based on the Ken Sugimori artwork of the character. It was also released as a in both expansions, with an illustration by Naoki Saito. Olivia allows the player to search their deck for up to 2 , reveal them, and put them into their hand. The player then shuffles their deck.

Olivia is the only Elite Four member.
